title: पहाड़ी पेट्रोल पंप के 3 खौफनाक नियम! ⛽😱 #shorts
topic: एक सुनसान पहाड़ी पेट्रोल पंप पर रात की शिफ्ट के भयानक नियम और एक रोंगटे खड़े कर देने वाला ट्विस्ट।
description:
अगर आधी रात को पहाड़ी हाईवे पर बिना लाइट की गाड़ी दिखे, तो ये नियम याद रखना! कबीर ने तो नियम मान लिया, पर क्या वो बच पाया? जानिए इस खौफनाक शॉर्ट में।

#RaatKeKisse #HindiHorror #HorrorShorts #Paranormal #ScaryStories

characters.कबीर: 25-year-old South Asian man, lean build, sharp worried jawline, short neat black hair, wearing a dark navy blue petrol pump attendant jacket with yellow collar over a black high-neck, blue jeans
characters.चाचा: 60-year-old South Asian man, weathered wrinkled face, thick grey moustache, intense sunken eyes, wearing an olive green woolen sweater and a maroon muffler wrapped around his neck

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: पहाड़ी मोड़ के इस सुनसान पेट्रोल पंप पर रात दो बजे के बाद सिर्फ तीन नियम चलते हैं।
scenes.visual: A lonely petrol pump on an isolated misty mountain highway at midnight, glowing under flickering dim fluorescent lights, dense fog, cinematic wide angle, 25-year-old South Asian man, lean build, sharp worried jawline, short neat black hair, wearing a dark navy blue petrol pump attendant jacket with yellow collar over a black high-neck, blue jeans standing near the pump.

scenes.speaker: O
scenes.text: कबीर, बिना हेडलाइट की कोई गाड़ी आए, तो रियर-व्यू मिरर में उसके ड्राइवर का चेहरा कभी मत देखना!
scenes.visual: Inside a dim glass pump cabin, 60-year-old South Asian man, weathered wrinkled face, thick grey moustache, intense sunken eyes, wearing an olive green woolen sweater and a maroon muffler wrapped around his neck, pointing a stern warning finger at 25-year-old South Asian man, lean build, sharp worried jawline, short neat black hair, wearing a dark navy blue petrol pump attendant jacket with yellow collar over a black high-neck, blue jeans, dramatic lighting, medium close-up.

scenes.speaker: M
scenes.text: और चाचा, अगर उसने पैसे माँगे या बात करने की कोशिश की तो?
scenes.visual: Close-up of 25-year-old South Asian man, lean build, sharp worried jawline, short neat black hair, wearing a dark navy blue petrol pump attendant jacket with yellow collar over a black high-neck, blue jeans, holding a vintage fuel nozzle, trembling hands, nervous expression, chilly breath in mist.

scenes.speaker: O
scenes.text: सिर्फ पाँच लीटर डालना, और जो भी पैसे मिले रख लेना... छुट्टे वापस मत करना!
scenes.visual: Low angle dramatic shot of 60-year-old South Asian man, weathered wrinkled face, thick grey moustache, intense sunken eyes, wearing an olive green woolen sweater and a maroon muffler wrapped around his neck, whispering with wide fearful eyes under shadows, ominous atmosphere.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: ठीक 2:15 पर कोहरे को चीरती हुई एक पुरानी काली विंटेज कार आई... हेडलाइट्स बिल्कुल बंद थीं।
scenes.visual: A vintage 1970s black sedan car arriving soundlessly at the petrol station through thick swirling mountain fog, pitch-black tinted windows, headlights turned off, eerie yellow pump light reflecting on the shiny black hood, eye-level shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: कबीर की साँसें थम गईं। उसने पाँच लीटर भरा, तभी खिड़की से एक बर्फीला सफेद हाथ बाहर आया।
scenes.visual: 25-year-old South Asian man, lean build, sharp worried jawline, short neat black hair, wearing a dark navy blue petrol pump attendant jacket with yellow collar over a black high-neck, blue jeans, nervously fueling the vintage black sedan, as a pale unnaturally slender human hand extends from the cracked car window holding an old 500-rupee note, cinematic side angle.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: कबीर ने नज़रें झुकाकर नोट ले लिया और नियम याद रखते हुए कोई छुट्टा वापस नहीं दिया।
scenes.visual: Close-up shot of 25-year-old South Asian man, lean build, sharp worried jawline, short neat black hair, wearing a dark navy blue petrol pump attendant jacket with yellow collar over a black high-neck, blue jeans, tightly gripping the faded currency note, keeping his eyes firmly cast on the wet tarmac, avoiding the car window.

scenes.speaker: G
scenes.text: कार के अंदर से एक ठंडी फुसफुसाहट आई—'मेरा बाकी का हिसाब कौन देगा, कबीर?'
scenes.visual: Side view of the black sedan with dark glass, faint glowing inhuman silhouette visible inside the darkness of the car, spooky cold breath condensing on glass, 25-year-old South Asian man, lean build, sharp worried jawline, short neat black hair, wearing a dark navy blue petrol pump attendant jacket with yellow collar over a black high-neck, blue jeans freezing in sheer panic.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: कबीर ने घबराकर केबिन की तरफ देखा... चाचा वहाँ नहीं थे, बल्कि दीवार पर उनकी श्रद्धांजलि वाली पुरानी तस्वीर टंगी थी!
scenes.visual: Point of view looking inside the glass cabin: the cabin is dusty and abandoned, cobwebs everywhere, with a garlanded black-and-white framed portrait of 60-year-old South Asian man with thick grey moustache and olive sweater hanging on the decayed wall, shock reveal lighting.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: और तभी... उस काली कार का दरवाज़ा धीरे-धीरे बाहर की तरफ खुलने लगा!
scenes.visual: Shocked terrifying close-up of 25-year-old South Asian man, lean build, sharp worried jawline, short neat black hair, wearing a dark navy blue petrol pump attendant jacket with yellow collar over a black high-neck, blue jeans, sweating and gasping in terror, as the heavy black car door creaks open behind him into darkness, sudden cliffhanger.
